gates.name: Razor components have no interface over a state class, no inline style block and no document type
gates.checks: It scans the source root for an `I*State` interface, an inline `<style>` block in a `.razor` file and a `<!DOCTYPE` outside the app component. It does not check attribute placement, which has its own gate. Exit 2 means `paths.sourceRoot` is not set, and it never exits 3.
gates.fix: Use the state class itself, move the styles into a `.razor.css` file, and keep the document type only in the app component.

gates.name: Component attributes sit on their own line above the member they mark
gates.checks: It scans the source root for a component attribute that shares a line with the member below it. It does not check the other rules of `Check-RazorConventions.ps1`. Exit 2 means `paths.sourceRoot` is not set, and it never exits 3.
gates.fix: Move the attribute onto its own line above its member.
